name: Pi_A Local Idempotent Persistence Proof Scaffold

candidate_statement.informal: Within a strictly local restricted domain, repeated application of Pi_A does not alter an already admissible continuation image.
candidate_statement.formal_draft: For local domain D_L, if x in Im(Pi_A) and excluded_domains(D_L)=false, then Pi_A(Pi_A(x)) ~ Pi_A(x).

proof_obligations.name: Admissible Image Membership
proof_obligations.requirement: Show that x remains inside Im(Pi_A) after first projection.

proof_obligations.name: Local Idempotence Preservation
proof_obligations.requirement: Use MT-001 to justify Pi_A o Pi_A ~ Pi_A only inside restricted local scope.

proof_obligations.name: Failure Boundary Exclusion
proof_obligations.requirement: Verify topology severance, identity ambiguity, oscillatory non-stabilization, and threshold metastability are excluded.

proof_obligations.name: No Persistence Overclaim
proof_obligations.requirement: State that idempotence of projection does not prove global basin persistence.
